scene_cards.dramatic_function: Establishes Mina's fatal illness and the strict time limit before salt-lung fever kills her.
required_beats: In the ocher sink infirmary, Jory sponges brine sweat from Mina's forehead as her cough thickens.
Apothecary Haddon scrapes the bottom of the medicine jar to show the blue lichen is entirely gone.
Haddon warns that salt-lung fever becomes fatal on the fourth day without treatment.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Reveals the town's resource crisis and provides the critical operational limitation of the respirator mask.
required_beats: What pushes this decision now, staged first: In the Ocher Sink infirmary, Jory watches his sister Mina struggle for breath as Apothecary Haddon reveals their supply of coastal blue lichen is gone.
Trader Varo refuses to share filtered brine from his private cistern without deed rights, mocking the town's dry pump.
Haddon rejects the predatory terms and inspects an old brass respirator mask.
Haddon observes that the mask's wax filter breaks down twice as fast in midday heat as in cold night air.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Forces Jory to take on the perilous solo journey across the flats to save his sister.

char_jory.goal: procure blue lichen medicine before Mina's fever turns

required_beats: Haddon explains that no adult miner will venture across the flats after the caravan vanished.
Haddon entrusts the syndicate token—a heavy brass guild token—and the respirator mask to Jory.
Jory tells Mina he will return before the fourth nightfall.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Launches Jory into the wastes equipped with the sled and vital survival constraints regarding the salt crust.
required_beats: At the basin gate, Talia checks the tow harness and bearings of a lightweight salt sled.
Talia warns that the fragile white salt crust gives way under more than eighty pounds, making Jory's light weight essential.
Talia opens the timber barrier and sends Jory out toward the coastal scrub.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Establishes Jory's perilous equipment vulnerability while allowing him to temporarily outmaneuver Varo's pursuit across the salt flats.

char_varo.goal: corner the town supply of clean water and medicine
intercept Jory and take the guild token
char_varo.status: mired on foot in salt mud

required_beats: What pushes this decision now, staged first: At the basin gate, Talia outfits Jory with a lightweight salt sled and warns him about the crust's load limits.
Jory steps onto the blinding white crust and equips his respirator, noticing ditch brine etching his spare quartz goggles and realizing his wax filter is dangerously degraded.
Trader Varo pursues him on an iron-framed outrigger sail-skiff, shouting across the flats to demand the syndicate token and brass token.
Jory lures the pursuit across the thin crust, where his lightweight sled traverses cleanly while Varo's heavy iron skiff breaks through and mires, forcing Varo to give chase on foot.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Escalates environmental pressure on Jory's dwindling physical endurance and failing respirator.

char_jory.status: fatigued and coughing from caustic dust

required_beats: A violent midday storm whips alkaline dust into blinding white squalls across the basin.
Jory restricts his respirator valve to protect his fragile wax filter from melting under the grit and heat, pressing forward blindly by compass through coughing fits.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Reveals the deliberate abandonment of the missing caravan and strips Jory of his supplies before he disables Varo in a desperate confrontation.

char_jory.status: fatigued and coughing from caustic dust

char_varo.status: mired on foot in salt mud

required_beats: Jory descends into the sunken crevasse field and finds the missing caravan wagons neatly unpacked and the draft beasts intentionally unhitched rather than destroyed.
A sudden sinkhole collapse swallows Jory's sled, canteen, and supplies into a deep chasm, leaving him stranded with only his mask and the brass token.
Varo arrives brandishing a heavy iron scraper, trapping Jory against a boiling brine pool to demand the guild token in exchange for water.
Jory splashes caustic ditch brine into Varo's quartz goggles to etch them blind in the glare, escaping up the salt ledge as Varo stumbles back into the ravine.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Brings Jory to safety at the edge of the coast at the absolute limit of his physical survival.
required_beats: Intense heat liquefies the remaining mineral wax in Jory's respirator, flooding his lungs with caustic gas as he climbs the final salt ridge.
Jory reaches the coastal scrub and collapses unconscious by the boundary marker, still clutching the guild token.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To expose Haddon's manipulative exploitation of Jory's loyalty and shatter his belief in the syndicate's mission.
required_beats: Jory wakes to clean sea air and fresh water at pelican wharf under the care of Burl, the vanished caravan driver.
Burl explains that the drivers defected to escape debt slavery rather than die in poison pits.
Burl reveals Haddon deliberately sent a child because only a boy bound to a dying sister would return instead of fleeing to the coast.
Jory realizes the town used his love for Mina as a hostage chain to haul medicine across the flats.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To test Jory's resolve with an offer of escape and establish his commitment to rescue his sister and free his people.

char_jory.goal: cross the salt flats to purchase blue lichen with the brass token
return to Ocher Sink to cure Mina and reveal the coast's freedom

required_beats: Orla seals a flask of blue lichen fever tincture, rejects the syndicate's brass token, and shows Jory how sea kelp strips serve as kelp filters against salt dust toxicity.
Orla offers Jory permanent sanctuary at the coast, urging him to abandon the greedy mining town to its fate.
Jory packs the blue lichen flask and wet sea kelp strips, declaring that abandoning Mina and the children pays the syndicate's price.
Jory refuses sanctuary and vows to return with the medicine to lead the townspeople out.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To establish an escape corridor and pact of mutual aid between the coast and the mining settlement.
required_beats: At pelican wharf, Burl tightens Jory's sea kelp wraps and provides a compass bearing along the firm salt ridge.
Burl promises the coastal docks will receive the refugees whenever Jory leads them out from ocher sink.
Jory steps back onto the salt pan at twilight to begin the return crossing.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To show Jory successfully mastering the deadly expanse using coastal knowledge and tools.
required_beats: Jory breathes easily through the moist sea kelp filters in the night brine haze without suffering lung damage.
Jory navigates along solid ridge lines to bypass the fragile sinkholes under the stars.
Before dawn, Jory sights the distant torches of ocher sink glowing along the basin rim.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Turns Talia against Varo by exposing the truth of the coast, winning Jory passage through the basin gate.

char_varo.status: disarmed and detained by gate guards

required_beats: Varo, with acid-burned eyes, demands Talia seize the medicine flask from Jory at the basin gate.
Jory refuses Varo's bribe, displays the sea-kelp filters, and reveals to Talia that the caravan drivers live freely at Pelican Wharf.
Talia orders the guards to disarm Varo and clears the gate path for Jory.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Pays off Jory's quest by saving Mina, exposing Haddon's complicity, and committing the settlement to flee the mines for the coast.
required_beats: In the infirmary before the fourth day deadline, Jory administers the blue lichen drops to Mina as her fever breaks and her breathing steadies.
Jory throws the useless syndicate token at Haddon's feet, confronting him with his betrayal and exposing how the town spent its children as hostages.
As Mina opens her eyes, Jory tells Haddon the mines are finished and the town will cross the flats together.

voice_card.register: plain, warmly ironic, folk-narrator; understates cruelty and wonder alike

metadata.title: The Salt Courier
metadata.source: segmented from a Fabula-only package by gemini-3.8-flash

facts.statement: Ocher Sink operates under perpetual bonded labor contracts owed to the salt-mining syndicate.
The missing caravan wagons were not pillaged by bandits but unpacked orderly with draft harness unhitched.
Apothecary Haddon chose Jory because an adult runner would defect whereas a boy with a dying sister is bound to return.
Trader Varo hoards clean water and remedies to force the town into extortionate debt.
Salt-lung fever turns fatal on the fourth day without coastal blue lichen.
Calibrated mineral wax filters dissolve twice as fast in midday heat than in night air.
Thin white salt crust collapses under loads over eighty pounds but supports a light runner.
Concentrated ditch brine rapidly clouds and etches untreated quartz safety goggles.
Fresh sea-kelp strips neutralize salt-lung toxins and can sustain an unmasked runner on the salt pan.

premise.logline: A boy sent to fetch medicine across the salt flats learns the town sent him because no one else would come back.

modules.theme: what a community owes the people it spends
modules.setting_time: the dry season, after the last caravan failed to return
modules.setting_place: a salt-flat crossing between a mining town and a coast
modules.protagonist: a twelve-year-old who has never left town
modules.protagonist_want: to bring the medicine back before his sister’s fever turns
modules.antagonism: the flats themselves, and a trader who profits from the shortage
modules.complication: the medicine is real, but so is the reason nobody else went
modules.ending_shape: he returns changed, and the town must change to take him back

plot_shape.name: Quest
plot_shape.central_question: What does the journey turn out to have been for?

phases.name: Lack
phases.purpose: Something is missing, and the protagonist is the one who must go.

phases.name: Departure
phases.purpose: Leaving costs something that will be missed later.

phases.name: Trials
phases.purpose: Obstacles that each take something and each teach something.

phases.name: The object
phases.purpose: The thing is reached, and is not what it was thought to be.

phases.name: Return
phases.purpose: Home, altered, judged against the lack that started it.

cast_roles.purpose: Goes, and is changed by going.
Hands over the means, with a condition attached.
Wants the object, or wants the seeker not to have it.

obligatory_moves: The means handed over early carries a limit that matters at the object.
At least one trial is lost, not won.
The return scene is set in the place the departure scene left.

beats: Jory sponges brine sweat from Mina's forehead as her cough thickens.
Haddon scrapes the bottom of the medicine jar, finding only dry mold.

Haddon refuses Varo's predatory trade and examines an old brass respirator mask.
Haddon notes that the mask's calibrated wax filter dissolves twice as fast in midday heat than in cold night air.

events.summary: Back at the infirmary, Haddon tasks Jory with crossing the flats alone, handing him the syndicate token while hiding why no adult was chosen.
events.dramatic_function: Complete the call to adventure and seal the contract between giver and seeker under false pretenses.
beats: Haddon explains that no adult miner will volunteer to cross after the caravan vanished.
Haddon presses the heavy brass guild token and the respirator into Jory's hands.
Jory promises Mina he will return before the fourth nightfall.

events.summary: At the basin gate, Talia outfits Jory with a lightweight salt sled and warns him about the crust's load limits.

Talia instructs Jory that the thin white salt crust collapses under loads over eighty pounds but safely bears a light boy.
Talia opens the timber barrier, bidding Jory make for the coastal scrub.

Varo shouts across the pan demanding Jory surrender the syndicate token.

events.dramatic_function: Pay off the crust load limit plant as Jory wins his first tactical escape.
beats: Jory sprints across the blinding white crust, listening to it creak beneath his boots.
Varo's heavy outrigger crashes through the brittle crust and jams into the sticky mud beneath.
Jory pulls ahead as Varo is forced to abandon the broken rig on foot.

state_changes.value: mired on foot in salt mud

events.summary: A violent midday salt storm sweeps across the basin, forcing Jory to choke his respirator airflow to conserve the fragile wax filter.
events.dramatic_function: Escalate the physical trial, inflicting respiratory toll on the protagonist.
beats: Gale winds whip caustic alkaline dust into blinding white squalls.
Jory narrows the respirator valve to prevent the heat and grit from liquefying the wax.
He struggles forward through coughing fits, marking his path by compass.

state_changes.value: fatigued and coughing from caustic dust

events.summary: Jory reaches the brine crevasse field and discovers the missing caravan's wagons resting intact in a dry salt trench.
events.dramatic_function: Transition to the halfway obstacle and introduce the physical remnants of the mystery.
beats: Jory guides his salt sled down a jagged ramp into the sunken crevasse field.
He spots three massive syndicate freight wagons wedged between salt pillars.
He approaches the silent wreckage to search for leftover water.

events.summary: Examining the caravan wagons, Jory discovers the freight was unpacked methodically and the draft beasts were unhitched rather than lost to disaster.
events.dramatic_function: Plant the physical clues proving the caravan did not perish but willingly walked away.
beats: Jory searches the wagon beds and finds empty crates neatly stacked without signs of violence.
He notices cut tether straps indicating the draft beasts were unhitched intentionally.
He finds boot tracks leading cleanly toward the coastal ridge.

events.summary: A treacherous brine sinkhole collapses beneath Jory, swallowing his salt sled, spare provisions, and canteen.
events.dramatic_function: Execute the lost trial requirement, stripping the seeker of survival gear and raising stakes.
beats: The salt crust fractures violently beneath the sled's runners.
Jory scrambles clear as the sled, water flasks, and spare supplies plunge into a deep brine chasm.
Jory is left clinging to the ridge with only his mask and the brass token in his coat.

events.summary: Varo catches up on foot at the crevasse rim, cornering the unarmed Jory against a boiling brine pool.
events.dramatic_function: Bring the obstructor to bear at the protagonist's lowest physical moment.
beats: Varo appears at the trench ledge wielding a heavy iron scraper.
Varo corners Jory against a pool of bubbling concentrated brine.
Varo demands Jory hand over the brass guild token in exchange for water.

events.summary: Jory scoops concentrated ditch brine onto Varo's quartz goggles, etching them instantly and allowing Jory to escape up the crevasse wall.
events.dramatic_function: Pay off the corrosive sludge plant to overcome the obstructor in close combat.
beats: Jory dips his glove into the caustic sludge and flings it straight into Varo's face.
The acidic brine instantly clouds and etches Varo's quartz lenses, blinding him in the white glare.
Jory scrambles up the salt ledge while Varo stumbles blindly into the ravine.

events.summary: As Jory reaches the scrubline bordering the coast, the midday heat completely liquefies his mask's wax filter and he collapses from caustic fumes.
events.dramatic_function: Pay off the filter degradation plant, concluding the trials phase with physical collapse.
beats: The afternoon heat dissolves the remaining mineral wax in the respirator, letting alkaline gas flood Jory's throat.
Jory staggers across the last salt ridge onto green coastal scrub.
He drops unconscious at the boundary marker, clutching the guild token.

events.summary: Jory awakens on the breezy docks of Pelican Wharf, cared for by Burl, the vanished caravan driver.
events.dramatic_function: Reorient the protagonist in the new world and reveal the survivor's true fate.
beats: Jory wakes to clean sea air and fresh water pressed against his lips.
He recognizes Burl, the veteran driver who vanished with the last freight.
Burl assures Jory that he is safe from the flats and the mining syndicate.

events.summary: Burl explains that the caravan did not perish but defected to escape debt slavery, revealing that Haddon sent a child because only a boy bound to a dying sister would return.
events.dramatic_function: Deliver the core thematic revelation and pay off the intact caravan tracks plant.
beats: Burl explains that the drivers abandoned their wagons to live as free folk rather than die in the poison pits.
Burl tells Jory that Haddon knew every adult courier would choose the coast, making an expendable boy with a sick sister their only hostage.
Jory realizes his town used his love for Mina as a chain to pull medicine across the flats.

events.summary: In the coastal storehouse, Herbalist Orla prepares the blue lichen tincture, offering Jory permanent sanctuary while equipping him with kelp filters.
events.dramatic_function: Grant the seeker the physical quest object while providing the means for a safe return.
beats: Orla seals a vial of blue lichen fever tincture and refuses the syndicate's worthless brass token.
Orla demonstrates how fresh sea-kelp strips neutralize salt dust toxicity without relying on mineral wax respirators.
Orla urges Jory to remain at the coast and let the mining town collapse on its own greed.

state_changes.value: decide whether to stay at the coast or carry the tincture back

events.summary: Jory rejects the coast's sanctuary, choosing to take the medicine back to save Mina and break the town's cycle of silence.
events.dramatic_function: Protagonist redefines his motivation: returning not as a compliant errand boy, but as an agent of change.
beats: Jory straps the tincture flask and wet sea-kelp breathing strips into his tunic.
He tells Burl and Orla that leaving Mina and the town's children to die pays the syndicate's price for them.
He declares he will return with the cure and lead the town out to the coast.

state_changes.value: return to Ocher Sink to cure Mina and reveal the coast's freedom

events.summary: At the wharf margin, Burl equips Jory for the return crossing and promises to hold the coastal trail open for Ocher Sink refugees.
events.dramatic_function: Initiate the return journey with newfound support and purpose.
beats: Burl secures Jory's sea-kelp wraps and gives him a compass bearing along the firm salt ridge.
Burl promises that when Jory returns with the townspeople, the coastal docks will receive them.
Jory steps back onto the salt pan as twilight sets over the flats.

events.summary: Guided by his new understanding of the salt ridges and sustained by the kelp filters, Jory crosses the expanse under the stars without suffering lung damage.
events.dramatic_function: Demonstrate mastery over the environment and pay off the coastal kelp neutralizer plant.
beats: Jory breathes easily through the moist sea-kelp strips despite the thick night brine haze.
He strides along the solid ridge lines, easily avoiding the fragile sinkholes.
He sights the torches of Ocher Sink glowing along the basin rim before dawn.

events.summary: At the basin gate, Jory confronts Talia and a scarred Varo, refusing Varo's bribe and rallying the gate guards with the truth of the coast.
events.dramatic_function: Defeat the obstructor politically at the threshold of home.
beats: Varo, with acid-burned eyes, demands Talia seize the medicine flask from Jory.
Jory displays the sea-kelp filters and reveals to Talia that the caravan drivers live freely at Pelican Wharf.
Talia orders the guards to disarm Varo and clears the gate path for Jory.

events.summary: In the infirmary where his journey began, Jory doses Mina before the fever's fourth day deadline, confronts Haddon with his betrayal, and commits the town to march for the coast.
events.dramatic_function: Resolve the central quest, deliver the final thematic reckoning, and pay off the deadline and collateral plants.
beats: Jory administers the blue lichen drops to Mina as her fourth-day fever breaks and her breathing steadies.
He throws the useless syndicate token at Haddon's feet, exposing how the town spent its children as hostages.
As Mina opens her eyes, Jory tells Haddon the mines are finished and the town will cross the flats together.

hidden_account.summary: The salt-mining syndicate in Ocher Sink placed all adult miners in unpayable debt bondage to prevent emigration to the coast.
Burl and his caravan drivers deserted the syndicate wagons at Pelican Wharf because they refused to return to perpetual labor in the mines.
Apothecary Haddon concealed the caravan's defection and decided to send a child courier because an adult would simply stay at the coast while Jory would return for his sister.
Trader Varo planned to seize the syndicate payment token and coastal medicine so he could force Ocher Sink into purchasing his private water reserves.

stakes.stake: Mina will die of salt-lung fever if medicine is not brought back before the fourth nightfall.
Trader Varo will intercept the guild token and seize control of all external medicine shipments.
Jory will suffocate on the salt flats if his deteriorating mask filter fails before reaching safety.
The townspeople of Ocher Sink will remain trapped in lethal debt servitude under the syndicate's lies.
